functions.behavior: Calls movement/update helpers, clears task fields, propagates direction and shifts three movement samples.
functions.regional_difference: USA requires override bit 0x8000 and masks to 0x3FF; JP copies any nonzero override without masking.
functions.unresolved: Whether this regional difference affects Ebi Slide or Superman needs runtime tracing.

functions.behavior: Selects update/action handlers using state, input masks and eligibility checks; increments or resets a secondary action counter.
functions.regional_difference: Similar dispatch structure, but USA and JP have different early checks and order; JP includes an extra magnitude/input test in this function.

functions.behavior: Initializes two movement parameters on first invocation, then waits for a float threshold; resets counter and selects action 0x47 or 0x4A, adding 0x200 modulo 0x400 to direction on the latter path.
functions.unresolved: Exact animation and action identities remain to be traced.

functions.behavior: Tests eligibility, input masks and absolute movement sample; selects action 0x17, 0x0D, 0x13 or 0, and conditionally clears or assigns movement parameter +0xE8.
When sample magnitude meets threshold, divides a constant by sample, caps divisor above at 8, interpolates initial toward target, clamps output above at target, and stores output times factor.
functions.regional_difference: Same reconstructed arithmetic and field layout, but different data symbols; literal equality and runtime role not assumed.

functions.behavior: Selects target 1.12 or 2.8 using a predicate, calls speed interpolation with factor 0.3, and maps returned bucket to actions 12 through 15; returns zero below sample threshold.
functions.unresolved: Exact predicate and role of each action need runtime confirmation.
